name: Batasia Loop
description: Spiral railway loop where the toy train makes a complete circle. War memorial and Kanchenjunga views.

name: Chowrasta (The Mall)
description: Heart of Darjeeling — pedestrian square with heritage buildings, pony rides, and mountain views.

name: Darjeeling Himalayan Railway
description: UNESCO World Heritage "Toy Train" running since 1881. 88 km narrow-gauge journey through tea gardens.

name: Ghoom Monastery (Yiga Choeling)
description: Oldest Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Darjeeling (1875). 15-ft clay statue of Maitreya Buddha.

name: Happy Valley Tea Estate
description: Working tea estate since 1854. Tour the factory and learn the process of making world-famous Darjeeling tea.

name: Himalayan Mountaineering Institute
description: Founded by Tenzing Norgay after Everest conquest. Museum of mountaineering history, equipment, and expeditions.

name: Japanese Peace Pagoda
description: White and gold Buddhist stupa built by the Japanese Buddhist order. Panoramic views and serene gardens.

name: Observatory Hill
description: Sacred hilltop with a temple shared by Hindus and Buddhists. Covered in prayer flags with Kanchenjunga views.

name: Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park
description: Home to red pandas, snow leopards, and Himalayan wolves. Successful red panda breeding program.

name: Rock Garden & Ganga Maya Park
description: Terraced garden with waterfalls and streams on a steep mountain slope. Connected by walking paths.

name: Tiger Hill
description: Sunrise viewpoint at 8,482 ft for spectacular views of Kanchenjunga and on clear days, Mt. Everest.

name: Bharat Bhavan
description: Multi-arts complex designed by Charles Correa. Galleries of contemporary art, poetry library, and performance spaces.

name: Taj-ul-Masajid
description: One of the largest mosques in Asia with pink sandstone facade and two 18-story minarets. Begun in 1844.

name: Tribal Museum (Museum of Man)
description: Open-air museum showcasing tribal habitats, art, and culture of Madhya Pradesh's indigenous communities.

name: Upper Lake (Bada Talab)
description: Oldest man-made lake in India (11th century). 31 sq km with boating, lake view promenade, and sunset point.

name: Van Vihar National Park
description: Urban safari park next to Upper Lake. Semi-captive big cats including tigers, lions, and leopards.

name: Bhuri Singh Museum
description: Houses Pahari miniature paintings, Chamba rumals (embroidered handkerchiefs), and ancient inscriptions.

name: Chamunda Devi Temple
description: Ancient hilltop temple with carved wooden panels and panoramic views of Chamba Valley.

name: Lakshmi Narayan Temple Complex
description: Six shikhara-style temples from 10th century. Finest examples of Nagara architecture in Himachal.

name: The Chaugan
description: Large central green in the heart of Chamba town. Venue for the famous Minjar Fair held every August.

name: Banke Bihari Temple
description: Most visited temple in Vrindavan dedicated to Krishna as Banke Bihari. Unique curtain-style darshan.

name: ISKCON Temple (Krishna Balaram Mandir)
description: International Hare Krishna temple founded by Prabhupada in 1975. Beautiful architecture and bhajan sessions.

name: Nidhivan
description: Sacred grove where Krishna is believed to perform Raas Leela every night. Locked after sunset.

name: Prem Mandir
description: Stunning modern white marble temple depicting Krishna's leelas. Spectacular at night with light show.

name: Ashokan Rock Edicts
description: Emperor Ashoka's 14 rock edicts from 250 BC carved on a boulder. Sanskrit and Prakrit inscriptions still legible.

name: Mahabat Maqbara
description: Jaw-dropping mausoleum blending Gothic, Indo-Islamic, and Hindu architecture. Silver doors and spiral staircases.

name: Uparkot Fort
description: 2,300-year-old fort with Buddhist caves, ancient stepwells, and cannons. 16-time siege survivor.

name: Bee Falls
description: Highest waterfall in Madhya Pradesh at 35 meters. Swimming pool at the base. Known as Jamuna Prapat.

name: Jata Shankar Caves
description: Natural cave formation resembling Shiva's matted hair (jata). Stalactites form a natural Shiva lingam.

name: Pandav Caves
description: Five rock-cut caves believed to be the shelter of Pandavas during exile. Buddhist period cave architecture.

name: Chadar Frozen River Trek
description: Legendary winter trek on the frozen Zanskar River through a gorge. Only January-February.

name: Padum
description: Capital of Zanskar at 11,500 ft. Traditional Zanskari houses, Karsha Monastery visible across the valley.

name: Phuktal Monastery
description: Spectacular cave monastery built into a cliff face over 2,500 years ago. Accessible only by foot.

name: Gomti Talav
description: Sacred lake near the temple. Ghats for bathing rituals. Serene early mornings.

name: Ranchhodrai Temple
description: Temple where Krishna's idol is believed to have followed a devotee from Dwarka. Millions visit during Sharad Purnima.

name: Khonoma Nature Conservation Trail
description: Forest trail through the community conserved area. Tragopan and other rare birds. Guided walks available.

name: Khonoma Village
description: Asia's first green village. Angami Naga village that banned hunting in 1998. Traditional terraced farming.

name: Konyak Naga Villages
description: Villages of the former headhunter Konyak tribe. Last tattooed headhunter warriors still alive here.

name: Shangnyu Village
description: Village with the Angh (chief)'s house. Skull trophies displayed from the headhunting era. Cultural immersion.

name: Great Stupa at Sanchi
description: UNESCO World Heritage Buddhist monument commissioned by Emperor Ashoka in 3rd century BC. Four ornate toranas (gateways).

name: Sanchi Archaeological Museum
description: Houses original artifacts from the stupa site including Ashoka's Lion Capital replica and Buddhist sculptures.

name: Hemkund Sahib
description: Sikh pilgrimage site at 15,200 ft — highest gurudwara in the world. Glacial lake surrounded by seven peaks.

name: Valley of Flowers National Park
description: UNESCO World Heritage Site. Alpine meadow with 600+ species of flowers including brahma kamal and blue poppy.

name: Deeg Palace
description: Exquisite water palace of Jat kings. Fountains designed to simulate monsoon with thunder-sound mechanism.

name: Lachen Monastery
description: Monastery of the Lachen people governed by the traditional Pipon council system. Remote and authentic.

name: Yadavindra Gardens (Pinjore Gardens)
description: Mughal-style terraced garden built by Fidai Khan. Seven terraces with fountains, palaces, and a mini zoo.
